root_cause.text: The TX packet buffer per queue was configured at 7 KB for TSN mode, exceeding the hardware-recommended size (5 KB per Section 7.5.4 of the I225/I226 SW User Manual), causing the TX unit to hang under heavy timestamping load due to resource contention or starvation.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The previous 7 KB per queue caused TX unit hangs under heavy timestamping load. Reducing to 5 KB avoids these hangs and matches the TSN recommendation in I225/I226 SW User Manual Section 7.5.4." The patch diff changes `IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN` from `IGC_TXPB0SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB1SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB2SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB3SIZE(7)` to `IGC_TXPB0SIZE(5) | IGC_TXPB1SIZE(5) | IGC_TXPB2SIZE(5) | IGC_TXPB3SIZE(5)`.

intent_record.what: Changed the constants in the IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN macro from 7 to 5 for TXPB0SIZE, TXPB1SIZE, TXPB2SIZE, TXPB3SIZE, and added a comment referencing the I225/I226 SW User Manual Section 7.5.4.
intent_record.how: This change reduces the TX packet buffer allocation for TSN mode from 7 KB to 5 KB per buffer, aligning with hardware specifications. The comment documents the source of the correct values.

candidates.rationale: Sets the TX packet buffer size per queue to 7 KB (via IGC_TXPB0SIZE, IGC_TXPB1SIZE, IGC_TXPB2SIZE) in the TSN configuration, exceeding the hardware-recommended 5 KB limit and causing the TX unit to hang under heavy timestamping load.
Sets the TX packet buffer size for the fourth queue to 7 KB in the TSN configuration, also exceeding the recommended 5 KB limit and contributing to resource contention that hangs the TX unit.

vuln_statements.explanation: Sets the TX packet buffer size for queues 0, 1, and 2 to 7 KB each in TSN mode, exceeding the hardware-recommended 5 KB per queue, causing resource contention that hangs the TX unit under heavy timestamping load.

Sets the TX packet buffer size for queue 3 to 7 KB in TSN mode, also exceeding the recommended 5 KB limit, contributing to the same resource starvation issue that hangs the TX unit under heavy timestamping load.
